metadata.description: AI-powered browser automation for Claude Code -- navigate, click, type, extract content, and automate workflows in real browsers. Supports MCP server and CLI daemon modes.

plugins.name: openbrowser
plugins.description: Browser automation MCP server with explicit application contexts and progressive disclosure -- uses 3.2x fewer tokens than Playwright MCP across 6 tasks. Modern clients create isolated contexts, then run async Python with browser functions; get_status and reset_browser expose recovery state. Includes persisted login sessions, CLI daemon workflows, and compact description mode.
